title: Refund eligibility
text: Refund requests must be submitted within 30 days of delivery. The order receipt is required for a refund.

title: Password reset links
text: A password reset link expires after 15 minutes. Each reset link can be used only once.

title: Critical incident response
text: Critical incidents require acknowledgement within 10 minutes. The on-call engineer owns the first response.

title: Audit log retention
text: Audit logs are retained for 90 days. Deletion requests require approval from the security owner.

title: Standard shipping
text: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Tracking becomes available after the carrier scans the parcel.

title: Privileged account MFA
text: Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for privileged accounts. Hardware security keys are the preferred authentication factor.

title: Database backups
text: Database backups run every 6 hours. Backup restoration is verified weekly in an isolated environment.

title: API rate limits
text: API clients may send 120 requests per minute. Exceeding this limit returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.

title: Order cancellation
text: An order can be cancelled before warehouse dispatch. After dispatch the customer must use the returns process.

title: Production deployment
text: Production deployments require a passing quality gate. A rollback owner must be named before deployment begins.

title: Temporary support access
text: Temporary support access expires after 4 hours. Access must be approved by the service owner.

title: Storage encryption
text: Customer records are encrypted at rest using AES-256. Encryption keys are rotated every 12 months.

title: Data export
text: A customer data export is delivered within 7 business days. The export uses an encrypted download link.

title: Webhook retries
text: Failed webhooks are retried 5 times with exponential backoff. Exhausted deliveries are sent to the dead-letter queue.

title: Refund payment method
text: Approved refunds return to the original payment method. Refund settlement takes 5 business days after approval.

title: Admin session timeout
text: Admin sessions time out after 20 minutes of inactivity. Re-authentication is required to continue the session.

title: Support attachment limits
text: Support ticket attachments have a maximum size of 25 MB. Executable attachments are blocked.

title: Service availability target
text: The monthly service availability target is 99.9 percent. Planned maintenance is announced 48 hours in advance.

title: Payment failure escalation
text: Repeated payment failures must be escalated to the payments team. Include the transaction ID and timestamp in the escalation.

title: Support data minimization
text: Support tickets must not contain full card numbers. Only the last 4 digits of a card may be recorded.

title: Refund eligibility
text: Refund requests must be submitted within 14 days of delivery. The order receipt is required for a refund.

title: Password reset links
text: A password reset link expires after 60 minutes. Each reset link can be used repeatedly.

title: Critical incident response
text: Critical incidents require acknowledgement within 60 minutes. The support intern owns the first response.

title: Audit log retention
text: Audit logs are retained for 7 days. Deletion requests require approval from any user.
